ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The system shown consists of three pulleys that are connected to each other via two ropes. $P$, the end of one rope, is pulled down by $24 \mathrm{~cm}$. By how many centimeters does point $Q$ move upwards?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has three pulleys. The uppermost pulley is fixed on a crossbeam; the rope end labeled P is pulled downward on the left side, and this rope (Seil 1) goes around the upper fixed pulley, then around the middle movable pulley, with the other end fixed at the upper crossbeam, so the middle pulley is supported by two vertical rope segments of Rope 1. Below the middle pulley is connected one end of a second rope (Seil 2); the second rope goes downward around the lowest movable pulley with Q, and the other end is fixed at the upper-right crossbeam. Q moves together with the lowest pulley. Reasoning: When P is pulled downward 24 cm, the free end of Rope 1 increases by 24 cm in length. Since the total length of Rope 1 remains unchanged, the supporting rope segments on the two sides of the middle movable pulley must shorten by 24 cm in total. The two segments shorten by equal amounts, so the middle pulley rises 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm. Next look at Rope 2: one of its ends rises 12 cm with the middle pulley, the other end is fixed above, and the lower Q pulley is supported by two segments of Rope 2. To keep the total length of Rope 2 unchanged, the lower pulley needs to rise by half of these 12 cm, that is, 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm. Therefore Q moves upward 6 cm.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a two-stage movable-pulley system. From the image, identify Rope 1: its free end is P, it passes over the upper fixed pulley, around the middle movable pulley, and its other end is fixed to the ceiling. Thus the middle pulley is supported by two vertical strands of Rope 1. If P is pulled downward 24 cm, conservation of Rope 1 length makes the two supporting strands shorten by 24 cm total, so the middle pulley rises 12 cm. Next identify Rope 2: one end is attached to the middle pulley block, it passes around the lower pulley carrying Q, and the other end is fixed to the ceiling. When the upper/middle attachment point rises 12 cm, Rope 2 length conservation means the lower pulley/Q rises half as much, 6 cm. Therefore Q moves upward 6 cm.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个滑轮。最上方滑轮固定在横梁上；标为 P 的绳端在左侧向下拉，这根绳子（Seil 1）绕过上方固定滑轮，再绕过中间的可动滑轮，另一端固定在上方横梁处，所以中间滑轮由 Rope 1 的两段竖直绳支撑。中间滑轮的下方连接第二根绳（Seil 2）的一端；第二根绳向下绕过最下方带有 Q 的可动滑轮，另一端固定在右上方横梁处。Q 与最下方滑轮一起运动。
推理：P 向下拉 24 cm 时，Rope 1 的自由端增加了 24 cm 的长度。由于 Rope 1 总长度不变，中间可动滑轮两侧的支撑绳段总共必须缩短 24 cm。两段等量缩短，所以中间滑轮上升 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm。接着看 Rope 2：它的一端随中间滑轮上升 12 cm，另一端固定在上方，下面的 Q 滑轮由两段 Rope 2 支撑。为保持 Rope 2 总长度不变，下方滑轮需要上升这 12 cm 的一半，即 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm。因此 Q 向上移动 6 cm。
